## Testing

## Checklist

- [ ] The project opens without Console errors.
- [ ] Relevant Edit Mode tests pass.
- [ ] Gameplay changes were checked in Play Mode.
- [ ] New or moved Unity assets include their `.meta` files.
- [ ] Documentation reflects user-visible or architectural changes.

## Notes
